rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account states that on the afternoon of 26 September 2006 安倍晋三 was designated by both Houses as the 90th Prime Minister (57th person), and that the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony and the ministers' attestation took place at the Palace that night, followed by a press conference and the first cabinet meeting.

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same page is headed 安倍内閣の発足 and quotes Abe saying he had organised the 'beautiful country' cabinet that day.
